definitions.explanation: The quality of being acidic; having a pH below 7.

examples.english: Acid rain is causing damage to forests.

notes:
{酸性|さんせい} describes the acidic property of a substance — having a pH below 7. Used in chemistry, agriculture, environmental science, and everyday contexts like food and skincare.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {酸性雨|さんせいう}: acid rain
- {酸性|さんせい}{土壌|どじょう}: acidic soil
- {酸性|さんせい}{食品|しょくひん}: acidic foods
- {弱酸性|じゃくさんせい}: mildly acidic (common in skincare products)

pH SCALE VOCABULARY:
- {酸性|さんせい}: acidic (pH < 7)
- {中性|ちゅうせい}: neutral (pH 7)
- アルカリ{性|せい}: alkaline/basic (pH > 7)

USAGE:
As a の-adjective: {酸性|さんせい}の{溶液|ようえき} (acidic solution). Also used directly before nouns in compounds: {酸性雨|さんせいう}. The term {弱酸性|じゃくさんせい} (mildly acidic) is widely known from skincare advertising.

HOMOPHONE:
Not to be confused with {賛成|さんせい} (approval, agreement).
